hypothesis: Showing the extractor the top-5 current same-scope memories inside the single extraction call, and letting it mark new facts duplicate_of/supersedes, recovers LongMemEval knowledge-update accuracy (-7.7 pt vs mem0 in evidence-2026-08-24) by invalidating stale facts, without regressing other categories or adding an LLM call.

baseline.note: Treatment runs add the reconcile block to the same baseline overrides; reconcile is the only changed variable.

stopRule: paired bootstrap CI plus exact McNemar on knowledge-update; default promotion additionally requires no significant overall regression on LongMemEval and LOCOMO holdout
